# Synthetic ICC fixtures

These profiles are generated by `scripts/corpus_synth.py` through
`synthetic_icc_profile`. ICC.1:2022 7.2, 7.3, 8.2, 10.6, 10.10, 10.18 and
10.31 define their encodings. The D50 colourants are the printed words used
by F-240's hand-derived library fixtures. No third-party profile is copied.

The source is [ICC.1:2022](https://www.color.org/specification/ICC.1-2022-05.pdf).
Little CMS 2.18 transicc accepts and converts each profile as an independent
host-side check. The viewer tests assert the approved plan's hand values.
The profiles carry the repository's MIT OR Apache-2.0 licence notice.
